At finite temperature, it manifests in hydrodynamics as constraints on macroscopic currents. As a result, nonuniform symmetries give rise to qualitatively new physical phenomena, including modified spectra of collective excitations, exemplified by transverse Tkachenko oscillations in quantum vortex crystals, and unconventional transport phenomena, such as anomalously slow diffusion and softened sound modes in dipole-conserving systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了处理非均匀对称性（与时空平移不对易的对称性）的多体系统统一框架，发现这类对称性不引入新的无带隙模式，而是通过约束现有自由度来重塑红外动力学，导致集体激发谱修正（如Tkachenko振荡）和反常输运现象（如慢扩散和软化声模）。
AI.motivation: 均匀对称性下的Goldstone定理和流体动力学已很成熟，但非均匀对称性（其生成元不与时空平移对易）的低能物理后果尚不清晰。这类对称性不引入额外无带隙模式，而是约束已有自由度，其机制缺乏统一理解。
AI.method: 发展了一个统一的理论框架：将非均匀对称性的效应视为额外场，但这些场在低能下非独立，可被消去，从而产生运动学约束。在零温下通过有效场论修改色散关系，在有限温度下通过流体动力学约束宏观流。
AI.result: 非均匀对称性软化剩余模式的色散关系（如量子涡旋晶体中的横向Tkachenko振荡）；在有限温度下导致反常输运（如偶极守恒系统中的异常慢扩散和软化声模）。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀对称性通过约束而非引入新模式来重塑红外物理，统一解释了多个看似不同的现象（Tkachenko振荡、慢扩散、软化声模），为研究这类对称性的低能后果提供了系统工具。

title: Semi-Empirical Kinetic Model for Phase Selection in Rapidly Solidified Multicomponent Concentrated Alloys
summary: A semi-empirical kinetic framework is formulated for predicting phase selection in multicomponent concentrated alloys under rapid solidification. The approach is based on the critical cooling rate required to suppress competing crystalline pathways and combines topology-dependent ranking of BCC-, FCC-, and HCP-like crystallization pathways with a correction for glass-forming ability. The formulation includes a topology-dependent viscosity correction with a smoothed BCC multiplier and a continuous correction factor for glass-forming ability based on mixing enthalpy, excess entropy, and atomic-size dispersion. Comparison with experimental and computational data shows that the kinetic criterion captures changes in the lattice type expected from the valence electron concentration criterion, describes kinetic suppression of phase separation, and identifies competitive multiphase crystallization. The model also distinguishes alloys with high and low glass-forming ability. The proposed framework provides a practical approach for preliminary evaluation of kinetic phase competition in rapidly solidified multicomponent melts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个半经验动力学框架，用于预测多元浓缩合金在快速凝固过程中的相选择，该框架基于临界冷却速率、拓扑依赖的结晶路径排序和玻璃形成能力校正，能有效捕捉晶格类型变化、动力学抑制相分离和识别多相结晶竞争。
AI.motivation: 多元浓缩合金在快速凝固过程中相选择复杂，现有理论难以同时预测晶格类型、相分离抑制和玻璃形成能力，亟需一个实用的动力学框架进行初步评估。
AI.method: 基于临界冷却速率抑制竞争结晶路径，结合拓扑依赖的BCC/FCC/HCP路径排序，引入拓扑依赖的粘度修正（BCC平滑乘子）和玻璃形成能力连续修正因子（混合焓、过剩熵、原子尺寸分散度）。
AI.result: 与实验和计算数据对比表明：该动力学准则捕捉了价电子浓度准则预期的晶格类型变化，描述了相分离的动力学抑制，识别了竞争性多相结晶，并区分了高/低玻璃形成能力合金。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为快速凝固多元熔体中动力学相竞争的初步评估提供了实用方法。

title: Fluctuation theorems for thermally isolated driven quantum systems: nonadiabaticity, excess work and strong inequalities
summary: We expand on the ideas developed by C. Jarzynski in Physica A 552, 122077 (2020), where an integral fluctuation theorem was derived with the aim of obtaining thermodynamic inequalities stronger than those implied by the Jarzynski equality. Restricting ourselves to the quantum setting, we derive the corresponding detailed fluctuation theorem and additional detailed and integral fluctuation theorems; we also provide a clear physical interpretation of the stochastic quantities defined in the previous reference. Furthermore, we show that their averages are given by the nonadiabaticity parameter (i.e., the relative entropy between the final state after a finite-time driving protocol and the corresponding adiabatically evolved state) and the excess work (also known as inner friction). We elaborate on the inequalities derived from the fluctuation theorems and discuss their connection to irreversibility and formulations of the Second Law.

AI.tldr: 该论文在量子框架下扩展了Jarzynski的积分涨落定理，推导了详细的涨落定理，并建立了随机量与绝热度参数（相对熵）和过剩功（内摩擦）之间的平均关系，进而讨论了相关热力学不等式与第二定律的关联。
AI.motivation: 旨在获得比Jarzynski等式更强的热力学不等式，并澄清此前文献中定义的随机量的物理意义。
AI.method: 将Jarzynski的经典积分涨落定理扩展到量子体系，推导了对应的详细涨落定理以及其他详细和积分涨落定理；给出了随机量的清晰物理解释。
AI.result: 证明了这些随机量的平均值等于非绝热度参数（最终态与绝热演化态之间的相对熵）和过剩功（内摩擦）；并从涨落定理推导出相关不等式。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果与不可逆性和第二定律的表述紧密相连，为量子热力学中的不等式提供了新的理论基础。

title: Strongly correlated quantum matter: t--J model, real-space pairing, spin-dependent masses, and atomicity in chemical bond and nanosystems
summary: I critically overview my research on strongly correlated fermion systems for almost five decades. It concentrated on: (i) the first derivation of what is now called the t--J model, comprising both the limit of Anderson kinetic exchange of spin--spin interaction in the Mott--Hubbard insulator and taking into account real-space pairing, subsequently applied to high-temperature superconductivity; (ii) the concept of spin-dependent heavy mass of quasiparticles in heavy-fermion systems, and (iii) the first nontrivial model of statistical thermodynamics of the Mott--Hubbard transition. Those three features, together with the specific quantum critical phenomena provide, in my view, fundamental components of the theory of strongly correlated fermions established in the 1960s. Some related questions such as introduction of atomicity in the chemical bonding (iv), and specific properties of correlated nanosystems within the rigorous EDABI (v) approach are also briefly elaborated at the end.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了作者近五十年在强关联费米子系统领域的研究，重点包括：(i) 首次推导出t-J模型，涵盖Mott-Hubbard绝缘体中的Anderson动力学交换自旋相互作用及实空间配对，后应用于高温超导；(ii) 重费米子系统中准粒子自旋依赖的重质量概念；(iii) Mott-Hubbard相变统计热力学的首个非平凡模型。此外还讨论了化学键中的原子性及关联纳米系统的EDABI方法。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在系统性地回顾自己近五十年来在强关联费米子系统中的核心贡献，梳理该领域基础理论的建立过程，并指出这些理论（t-J模型、重费米子重质量、Mott-Hubbard相变）与量子临界现象共同构成了20世纪60年代建立的强关联费米子理论的基本组成部分。
AI.method: 采用批判性综述方法，作者按时间线和研究主题（t-J模型的推导、重费米子重质量、Mott-Hubbard相变统计热力学模型、化学键原子性、EDABI方法）依次阐述其理论推导和物理见解，并结合量子临界现象进行综合论述。
AI.result: 作者指出其三个主要贡献——t-J模型（含Anderson动力学交换和实空间配对）、自旋依赖重质量准粒子概念、Mott-Hubbard相变统计热力学模型——与特定量子临界现象共同构成强关联费米子理论的基础。
AI.conclusion: 强关联费米子系统理论的基础框架在20世纪60年代已确立，其中t-J模型、重费米子重质量概念和Mott-Hubbard相变模型是关键组成部分；化学键原子性和EDABI方法等后续研究为该领域提供了进一步扩展。

title: Unlocking ultrafast spin dynamics in a rare-earth magnet
summary: The speed of optically driven magnetization dynamics is fundamentally determined by how efficiently angular momentum can be transferred between electronic, spin and lattice degrees of freedom. In rare-earth magnets, this process is typically slow because optical excitation primarily addresses itinerant electrons, whereas the magnetic moment resides in localized 4f states. Here we show that selective optical excitation of localized magnetic states can overcome this limitation. Using femtosecond pump-probe magneto-optical spectroscopy of ferrimagnetic gadolinium iron garnet, we resonantly excite an intra-4f transition of Gd3+ at 4.65 eV and resolve the ensuing dynamics of the antiferromagnetically coupled Gd and Fe sublattices. Direct excitation of the 4f manifold induces an ultrafast demagnetization of the Gd sublattice with a characteristic time of 38 fs, more than two orders of magnitude faster than in elemental gadolinium and even faster than the response of the Fe sublattice in the same material. By contrast, off-resonant excitation strongly suppresses the acceleration of the Gd dynamics while leaving the Fe response largely unchanged. These results demonstrate that the ultrafast magnetic response of rare-earth systems is governed not only by intrinsic material properties but also by the optical excitation pathway. Selective access to localized magnetic states therefore provides a powerful photonic handle for engineering angular-momentum flow and controlling magnetism far from equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过飞秒泵浦-探测磁光光谱学，证明选择性激发稀土离子Gd³⁺的局域4f电子态可在38飞秒内实现超快退磁，比传统元素Gd快两个数量级以上，揭示了光学激发路径对超快磁响应的决定性作用。
AI.motivation: 稀土磁体中光学驱动的磁化动力学速度受限于角动量在电子、自旋和晶格之间的传递效率，因为常规光学激发主要作用于巡游电子，而磁矩却位于局域的4f态。作者希望克服这一限制，探索能否通过选择性激发局域磁态来实现超快磁响应。
AI.method: 使用飞秒泵浦-探测磁光光谱学技术，在铁磁性钆铁石榴石(GdIG)中，以4.65 eV的光子能量共振激发Gd³⁺的4f内跃迁，同时解析反铁磁耦合的Gd和Fe子晶格的动力学响应，并与离共振激发情况对比。
AI.result: 共振激发Gd³⁺的4f态诱导Gd子晶格在38飞秒内实现超快退磁，比元素Gd快两个数量级以上，甚至快于同材料中Fe子晶格的响应。而离共振激发则显著抑制了Gd动力学加速，对Fe响应影响不大。
AI.conclusion: 稀土系统的超快磁响应不仅由本征材料性质决定，还取决于光学激发路径。选择性激发局域磁态为工程化角动量流和远离平衡态控制磁性提供了强大的光子学手段。

title: Confinement drives valley splitting above 4K in buried silicon quantum wells
summary: Controlling the energy scales of a quantum system is essential for defining robust qubits. In silicon spin qubits, the nearly degenerate conduction-band valleys create a leakage channel from the single-spin computational basis, posing a challenge to scaling and to shuttling-based architectures. Here, we measure the relevant energy scales of single-electron spin qubits in buried silicon quantum wells co-designed for low disorder and high valley splitting. Across a linear array of four quantum dots with an average orbital energy of 2.4(2) meV, we report an average single-electron valley splitting of 0.40(6) meV and an average two-electron singlet-triplet splitting of 0.24(7) meV. In three dots, we observe a strong correlation between valley splitting and orbital energy, with an average linear coefficient of $\approx 0.22$ (meV/meV), demonstrating that electrostatic confinement can increase the valley splitting by several hundred microelectronvolts. In contrast, the remaining dot exhibits the highest valley splitting of 0.76(2) meV and low correlation, suggesting excellent characteristics for spin-qubit operation. Our findings demonstrate that strong confinement can be exploited in buried quantum wells to effectively enhance the valley splitting, thereby establishing a viable path toward the realization of shuttling and sparse-occupation-based architectures in low-disorder heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了埋层硅量子阱中单电子自旋量子点的能量尺度，发现通过强静电约束可以将谷分裂提升数百微电子伏，为自旋量子比特的扩展和穿梭架构提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: 硅自旋量子比特中，导带谷的近乎简并会导致单自旋计算基底的泄漏，成为扩展和穿梭架构的主要障碍，因此需要测量并控制相关能量尺度。
AI.method: 在低无序、高谷分裂的埋层硅量子阱中，对四个量子点组成的线性阵列进行单电子自旋量子比特能量尺度的测量，分析谷分裂与轨道能量的相关性。
AI.result: 平均轨道能量2.4(2) meV，平均单电子谷分裂0.40(6) meV，平均两电子单重态-三重态分裂0.24(7) meV。三个量子点中谷分裂与轨道能量强相关（系数≈0.22），证明静电约束可提升谷分裂数百微电子伏；另一个量子点谷分裂最高达0.76(2) meV且相关性低，适合自旋量子比特操作。
AI.conclusion: 强约束可在埋层量子阱中有效增强谷分裂，为实现低无序异质结构中的穿梭和稀疏占据架构提供了可行路径。

title: Symmetry-Protected Pinch Curves in Classical Spin Liquids
summary: Classical spin liquids are correlated paramagnets in which local constraints generate extensive degeneracy and emergent gauge structures, often observable as pinch-point singularities in spin structure factors. Here we introduce pinch-curve spin liquids, in which the pinch singularities form one-dimensional algebraic curves in momentum space. Inversion symmetry protects these curves by reducing the singularity condition to two real algebraic constraints in three dimensions, and the geometry of the pinch locus is algebraically programmable. We identify elementary mechanisms for generating straight and curved pinch loci, construct lattice spin models that realize them, and test the predicted structure factors using Monte Carlo simulations. We further show that pinch curves can host an infrared Gauss-law transition: the leading local constraint and the associated anisotropic scaling of the structure factor change, even though the singular locus remains one-dimensional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型自旋液体——"pinch-curve自旋液体"，其奇异点沿动量空间中的一维代数曲线分布，而非传统自旋液体中的孤立点。通过晶格模型和蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该理论，并发现了红外高斯定律相变现象。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋液体仅存在点状奇异点（pinch points），作者希望探索是否存在更高维度（一维曲线）的奇异结构，从而扩展自旋液体的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析结合晶格模型构建，利用蒙特卡洛模拟计算结构因子，验证预测的奇异曲线特征。
AI.result: 成功实现了直线和弯曲的pinch曲线；发现红外高斯定律相变——主导局域约束变化但奇异曲线维度保持不变。
AI.conclusion: Pinch-curve自旋液体扩展了经典自旋液体的分类，为研究奇异几何与约束物理的相互作用提供了新平台。

title: Electronic manipulation of polar order in electron crystal
summary: When interaction among atoms or ions is strong enough, they often arrange periodically, forming a crystal. The arrangement patterns of atoms or ions can encode information, a concept that has enabled devices such as ferroelectric memories. It has been found that not only atoms or ions but also electrons in condensed matter can crystallize when Coulomb interaction is strong enough. Typical examples are charge-ordered states in solids, where different valences, or different electron numbers, of an ion spontaneously form a spatial pattern on the lattice. In such electron crystals, information is expected to be encoded into the electron-ordering patterns. Here, we demonstrate electronic manipulation and readout of charge-ordering directions in a paramagnetic semiconductor LuFe$_2$O$_4$. By applying current pulses at room temperature, we observed that the non-reciprocal resistivity of LuFe$_2$O$_4$ is modulated along with a sign reversal, which disappears above the charge-ordering temperature. A numerical calculation incorporating inter-band Berry curvature affected by the charge ordering is consistent with the experimental results. By applying the observed phenomenon, we also demonstrate a non-reciprocal resistance memory operation in the charge-ordered LuFe$_2$O$_4$. This result opens the door to realizing charge-ordering electronics.

AI.tldr: 本文在半导体LuFe₂O₄中通过电流脉冲实现了电荷有序方向的操作与读取，展示了基于电子晶体的非互易电阻记忆器件，为电荷有序电子学开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 电子晶体（电荷有序态）具有空间有序的电子排布模式，理论上可用于信息编码。然而，如何对电子晶体的有序方向进行电学操控和读取尚待探索，本文旨在实现这一目标。
AI.method: 在室温下对LuFe₂O₄施加电流脉冲，观测非互易电阻率的变化与符号反转；结合考虑能带Berry曲率的数值计算以解释实验结果。
AI.result: 电流脉冲可调制LuFe₂O₄的非互易电阻率并使其符号反转，该效应在电荷有序温度以上消失。数值计算与实验结果一致。基于此现象实现了非互易电阻记忆操作。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在电荷有序材料中可实现电学操控和读取电子有序方向，展示了电荷有序电子学的可行性。

title: Silicon-Germanium Heterostructures with Enhanced Valley Splitting for Spin Qubits
summary: Achieving valley splittings well in excess of the thermal energy of electrons and avoiding valley excitations is essential for the consistent initialization, operation and readout of gate-defined Si spin qubits. In this work, we present a device-level optimization strategy for pushing valley splittings to between 1 and 5 meV, well beyond values reported in nearly all previous theoretical studies. Using device-scale simulations that incorporate atomistic alloy disorder through a 1D tight-binding theory, we demonstrate that our proposed approach yields large valley splittings with a tight distribution across disorder realizations, a key requirement for reproducible qubit performance at scale. The approach rests on an unorthodox Si/SiGe heterostructure design combining a narrow quantum well, a small Ge spike, and a pure-Ge cap. We corroborate these predictions with targeted atomistic density functional theory calculations. These results offer a clear path forward for scalable Si/SiGe spin qubit devices and, if realized experimentally, effectively eliminate valley splitting as an existential problem for large scale SiGe-based quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种器件级优化策略，通过结合窄量子阱、小Ge尖峰和纯Ge帽层的非传统Si/SiGe异质结构设计，将谷分裂值提升至1-5 meV，远超以往理论结果，并通过大规模器件模拟和DFT计算验证，有望消除谷分裂对SiGe自旋量子比特可扩展性的根本限制。
AI.motivation: 当前Si自旋量子比特面临谷分裂不足（通常远小于电子热能量）的问题，导致量子比特的初始化、操作和读出不一致。同时，谷分裂在不同无序实现中分布宽泛，难以实现可重复的量子比特性能，亟需一种能稳定提升谷分裂值并控制其分布的器件设计策略。
AI.method: 采用结合一维紧束缚理论的器件级大规模模拟来纳入原子尺度的合金无序效应；提出非传统的Si/SiGe异质结构：窄量子阱 + 小Ge尖峰 + 纯Ge帽层；通过第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行针对性验证。
AI.result: 新设计在多个无序实现中均能稳定获得1-5 meV的大谷分裂值，分布紧密，远超以往理论工作报道的数值。DFT计算进一步支持了这些预测。
AI.conclusion: 该策略为可扩展的Si/SiGe自旋量子比特器件提供了明确可行的路径；若在实验中实现，将有效消除谷分裂问题作为大规模SiGe量子处理器存在的根本性障碍。

title: Quantum Chaos with a Macroscopic Zero-Mode Sector
summary: Chaotic many-body spectra are expected to densely fill their energy window. We show that constrained spin chains with chiral symmetry evade this expectation by hosting an exponentially large manifold of symmetry-protected exact zero modes separated from the surrounding spectrum by a sharp gap at zero energy. The gap is generated by chaotic level repulsion, with width set by the number of zero modes times the mean level spacing. We verify this mechanism in an East-West kinetically constrained chain, develop a minimal random-matrix description, and show how the gap can be detected through linear-response spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文发现手性对称约束自旋链中的零能模被混沌能级排斥打开一个尖锐能隙，并通过East-West模型、随机矩阵理论和线性响应谱学验证了这一机制。
AI.motivation: 混沌多体谱通常密集填充整个能量窗口，但作者想探究手性对称约束自旋链是否能打破这一预期，在零能处形成特殊结构。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析手性对称保护零模的指数大流形；2. 在East-West动力学约束链中数值验证；3. 建立最小随机矩阵描述；4. 提出线性响应谱学检测方案。
AI.result: 零模与周围谱之间存在尖锐能隙，能隙宽度由零模数量乘以平均能级间距决定，且该能隙由混沌能级排斥产生。
AI.conclusion: 手性对称约束系统可产生被能隙隔离的零模流形，该现象可通过线性响应谱学实验检测。

title: Unraveling atomic-resolution valence electron energy-loss spectroscopic imaging in a single-crystal CaNb2O6
summary: Despite advancements in electron optics and spectrometer design over the past twenty years, atomic-resolution valence-electron energy-loss spectroscopy imaging remains challenging due to the delocalization of inelastic electron scattering. In this study, we used an energy-filtered spectrometer equipped with a hybrid-pixel direct electron detector and spherical aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy to analyze many-electron excitations and interband transitions in a single-crystal calcium niobate, CaNb2O6, with spatial resolution ranging from the nanometers to the atomic scale. In the low-loss region above the bandgap at about 3.8 eV, we observed volume plasmons, around 6 eV and 15 eV energy loss, as well as a mix of strongly correlated plasmons and excitons, known as plexcitons, at approximately 7.3 eV energy loss. Additionally, we employed an on-axis EELS setup for atomic-resolution zero-loss peak (ZLP) imaging and visualized energy- and atom-resolved images of plexcitons and VPs, which showed contrast reversal relative to high-angle annular dark-field images. To investigate elastic contrast preservation, we also analyzed the effect of the collection angle and minimized its influence to produce delocalized VP images. In fact, the ZLP and VEELS images obtained using the weak-beam setup demonstrate that, in both cases, the contrast resembles Z-contrast. Moreover, we found that [NbO6] octahedra directly contributed to the lateral maps of interband transitions in the range from 3.2 eV to 3.5 eV energy loss. These findings demonstrate that Cs-STEM-EELS, which examines atomic-scale contrast associated with low-energy losses, can be a powerful tool for visualizing the structure, bonding, and electronic properties of complex crystalline nanostructures, including individual atomic sites, interstitial sites, and point defects.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜结合混合像素直接电子探测器的能量过滤光谱仪，在CaNb2O6单晶中实现了从纳米到原子尺度的低损耗电子能量损失谱成像，观测到了体积等离激元、plexcitons以及原子分辨的零损失峰成像，并发现[NbO6]八面体直接贡献于带间跃迁的横向分布图。
AI.motivation: 尽管近二十年电子光学和光谱仪设计取得了进步，但原子分辨率的价电子能量损失谱成像仍然具有挑战性，因为非弹性电子散射具有离域特性。本研究旨在克服这一困难，实现原子尺度的低损耗EELS成像。
AI.method: 使用配备混合像素直接电子探测器的能量过滤光谱仪和球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜，采用on-axis EELS设置进行原子分辨率零损失峰成像，并分析收集角对弹性对比度的影响，采用弱束设置进行成像。
AI.result: 在CaNb2O6中观测到约3.8 eV带隙以上的体积等离激元（约6 eV和15 eV）、plexcitons（约7.3 eV）；实现了原子分辨的ZLP和VEELS成像，观察到与HAADF像相反的对比度；发现[NbO6]八面体直接贡献于3.2-3.5 eV的带间跃迁横向分布图。
AI.conclusion: Cs-STEM-EELS通过考察低能损失相关的原子尺度对比度，可以成为可视化复杂晶体纳米结构（包括单个原子位点、间隙位点和点缺陷）的结构、键合和电子特性的有力工具。

title: A nonstandard statistics for strongly correlated systems: Two simple examples
summary: We discuss two different cases of strongly correlated fermions statistics. The first of them is the non-Fermi liquid (NFL) case, $i.e.$, that of fermions with exclusion of doubly occupancy of quasimomentum states $\{\bf k\}$ with opposite spins ($\uparrow\downarrow$). The second is that of statistical spin liquid (SSL) case, in which the fermion spins hop around and mix with the holes (unoccupied) states. For both cases we calculate the system entropy and the corresponding statistical distribution function, analyzed for a two-dimensional square-lattice filling $n\in [0,1]$ and relative temperature $k_B T/|t|$, where $t<0$ is the nearest neighbor hopping integral. We are particularly interested in the situation when the system of itinerant fermions reduce to the Mott-insulator state for the half-filled band ($n\to1$). This limiting situation signals a qualitative difference between the present SSL statistics and that of uncorrelated fermions representing normal Fermi-liquid state.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种强关联费米子统计情况：非费米液体（NFL）和统计自旋液体（SSL），计算了它们的熵和统计分布函数，并分析了二维正方格子填充和温度的影响，特别关注半填充时向Mott绝缘体态的转变。
AI.motivation: 理解强关联费米子系统中非费米液体和统计自旋液体的统计行为，并探究它们与正常费米液体在Mott绝缘体转变中的本质区别。
AI.method: 对两种情形（NFL和SSL）分别计算系统熵和统计分布函数，在二维正方格子填充数n∈[0,1]和相对温度k_B T/|t|下进行分析。
AI.result: 在半填充极限（n→1）下，系统演变为Mott绝缘体态，此时SSL统计与无关联费米子（正常费米液体）统计表现出定性差异。
AI.conclusion: 统计自旋液体（SSL）在强关联极限下展现出与正常费米液体截然不同的统计行为，揭示了Mott转变中统计效应的关键作用。

title: Thermalization in a Height-Conserving Quantum Dimer Model
summary: Strongly constrained quantum systems, in which local rules forbid most configurations, play a central role in condensed matter and lattice gauge theory. Their thermalization is often thought to be delicate: extensive conservation laws and dynamically frozen states can shatter the Hilbert space into many disconnected sectors. A natural question is whether, once the frozen states are removed, the dynamics within a single sector still thermalizes. We address this in the height-conserving quantum dimer model on the square lattice, whose local plaquette flips conserve an emergent height field. Resolving the winding numbers, the four sublattice heights, and lattice momentum , we isolate the dominant connected Krylov component of each fragmented sector and analyze its spectral spectral statistics, entanglement, and connectivity. The two standard chaos diagnostics then show different behavior:across momentum sectors the level-spacing statistics range from near-Poisoon to Wigner-Dyson, yet in every sector the eigenstate entanglement entropy collapses onto a narrow, dome-shaped curve characteristic of eigenstate thermalization. Only a handful of low-entanglement outliers interrupt this thermal pattern, in selected sectors. Thus, strong kinematic constraints can lead to a situation where spectral correlations and eigenstate thermalization need not follow the same universal signatures -- a manifestation of constrained quantum chaos.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高度守恒量子二聚体模型中的热化问题，发现谱统计和本征态热化可以表现出不一致的行为，即“约束量子混沌”现象。
AI.motivation: 强约束量子系统通常被认为热化困难，但作者想探究在去除冻结态后，单个扇区内是否仍然能够热化。
AI.method: 通过解析缠绕数、四子晶格高度和晶格动量，隔离每个碎片化扇区的主导连通Krylov分量，并分析其谱统计、纠缠和连通性。
AI.result: 不同动量扇区的能级间距统计从近泊松分布到Wigner-Dyson分布不等，但每个扇区的本征态纠缠熵都落在窄而穹顶形的曲线上，符合本征态热化假设。仅少数低纠缠离群值出现在特定扇区。
AI.conclusion: 强运动学约束会导致谱相关性与本征态热化不必遵循相同的普适性特征，这体现了约束量子混沌的独特表现。
